speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor
text:
The normal cystoscopy rules out bladder pathology, so I must consider upper urinary tract issues or systemic causes. Do you have any history of hematuria in family members, and have you noticed any joint pain or skin rashes recently?

text: RESULTS: Multiple cysts present in the collecting ducts of the medulla. No obstruction noted.

text:
The renal ultrasound revealing multiple cysts in the medullary collecting ducts is a classic finding for this specific condition, especially given your history of recurrent UTIs and sterile hematuria. I have enough information to confirm the diagnosis.
